nphi.title: IANPHI Europe Regional Network
nphi.actor: IANPHI Europe Regional Network (chair: Public Health Center of Ukraine)
nphi.with: Public Health Center of the MoH of Ukraine (chair); Austrian National Public Health Institute GÖG (vice chair); 42 member NPHIs
nphi.summary: Network of 42 European NPHIs holding annual meetings (supported by IANPHI since 2006) on health security, climate, data and the future role of NPHIs.

nphi.title: 2025 IANPHI Europe Regional Network Meeting (Oslo)
nphi.with: GÖG; PHC Ukraine; RIVM; ISS; IPH Serbia; IHMT; Santé publique France; INSPQ; Public Health Wales; ECDC; WHO Europe; WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence; DG HERA
nphi.summary: FHI hosted European NPHIs on their role in health security preparedness, medical countermeasures and resilience amid funding shifts and misinformation.

nphi.title: CLIMOS – Climate monitoring and decision support for sand fly-borne diseases
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); Ministry of Health of Türkiye; Ministry of Health of Israel; Italian Ministry of Health; Hacettepe and Ege universities; University of Haifa; Institute for Medical Research Belgrade; Charles University; Wageningen University; INSERM; UFZ; KIT
nphi.summary: Horizon Europe climate-and-health project building an early-warning and decision-support framework for sand fly-borne diseases (e.g. leishmaniasis) under climate change across the Mediterranean, with Italy's ISS and Turkish, Israeli and…

nphi.title: Integrated water and sanitation safety plans in small supplies in Serbia
nphi.with: Institute of Public Health of Serbia 'Dr Milan Jovanović Batut'; German Environment Agency (UBA)
nphi.summary: RIVM coordinated the piloting of combined water and sanitation safety planning for rural supplies in Serbia, with training for local and national public health institutes.

nphi.title: Strengthening Biosecurity in Southeast and Eastern Europe (Biosecurity SEEE)
nphi.with: Georgian NCDC; Bundeswehr Institute of Microbiology; GIZ; BACAC; WHO; US DTRA; ISTC; STCU
nphi.summary: RIVM coordinated needs-based biosafety and biosecurity capacity building, including national assessments, pathogen inventories and train-the-trainer courses in Georgia.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P44 – CBRN preparedness and response enhancement in South East and Eastern Europe
nphi.with: SCK CEN (Belgium); ISEM Institute; IRE-ELiT
nphi.summary: RIVM led the work package that produced a country report for each of the nine partner countries, plus train-the-trainer materials and exercise guidance, to strengthen how first responders handle CBRN incidents.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P57 – CBRN crime scene forensics in South East and Eastern Europe
nphi.with: SCK CEN (coordinator); Netherlands Forensic Institute; INCC Belgium; Forensic Science Centre Ivan Vučetić; ISEMI
nphi.summary: RIVM led the project, which trained forensic investigators to collect evidence at CBRN incident scenes, wrote procedures, and ran six sub-regional exercises.

nphi.title: STEP – immunisation policy capacity
nphi.summary: Building technical capacity for evidence-based decisions on immunisation policies in 16 countries of the WHO European Region.

nphi.title: PACT-PHM – Partnerships for population health metrics capacities and tools
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Europe (Denmark); Sciensano (Belgium)
nphi.summary: Builds national capacity to produce burden-of-disease and other population health metrics and embed them in health information systems for policy use.

nphi.title: ECDC MoUs with Serbia, North Macedonia and Ukraine (2025)
nphi.with: Institute of Public Health of Serbia; Institute of Public Health of North Macedonia; Ministry of Health of Ukraine
nphi.summary: In 2025 ECDC signed memoranda of understanding with Serbia's and North Macedonia's institutes of public health and Ukraine's Ministry of Health, alongside those with other enlargement countries, to prepare them for EU integration of…

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 110 – One Health Secure
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); CSIC; IRD; IZS Teramo; AVIA-GIS
nphi.summary: EU CBRN Centres of Excellence project in which Institut Pasteur and Italy's ISS, with veterinary and research partners, help Mediterranean, Black Sea and Sahel countries prepare for climate-sensitive vector-borne diseases through One…

nphi.title: SECID – South East European Center for Surveillance and Control of Infectious Diseases
nphi.actor: SECID / Institute of Public Health, Albania (SEEHN)
nphi.with: South East European Center for Surveillance and Control of Infectious Diseases (Tirana); South-eastern Europe Health Network (SEEHN); national public health institutes of the region; CORDS network; assisted by US CDC
nphi.summary: Regional centre set up in Tirana in 2013 under SEEHN, linked to Albania's Institute of Public Health, that supports national authorities across South-East Europe on influenza and respiratory-pathogen surveillance, pandemic preparedness…

nphi.title: EMIS-2023 – European MSM internet survey extended to Eastern Europe/Central Asia
nphi.with: Deutsche Aidshilfe (Germany); ECOM – Eurasian Coalition on Health, Rights, Gender and Sexual Diversity; SEE RCN – South Eastern Europe Regional TB and HIV Community Network
nphi.summary: Extended online health and behaviour surveys among MSM to EECA and Western Balkans to strengthen HIV/STI surveillance.

nphi.title: WASP – Western Balkan strategic partnership for health protection
nphi.with: Institute of Public Health (Montenegro); Clinical Center of Montenegro; Institute of Public Health (Albania); Institute for Public Health FBiH (Bosnia and Herzegovina); Public Health Institute Republika Srpska; National Institute of Public Health (Kosovo); Institute of Public Health (North Macedonia); Faculty of Medicine, University of Belgrade; City Institute of Public Health Belgrade (Serbia)
nphi.summary: Built epidemiological preparedness, workforce training and molecular lab capacity against infectious threats in the Western Balkans.

nphi.title: EU Twinning: Strengthening the capacity of Serbia's health sector for communicable disease surveillance
nphi.actor: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
nphi.with: Institute of Public Health of Serbia 'Dr Milan Jovanović Batut'; Ministry of Health of Serbia
nphi.summary: A €1 million EU twinning in which THL helped harmonise laboratory capacity, training, IT and data flows across Serbia's public health institute network.

nphi.title: JA TERROR – Preparedness and response to biological and chemical terror attacks
nphi.with: Sciensano; RIVM; NIJZ; Serbian and UK partner institutes not named on the source page
nphi.summary: Strengthened cross-sector preparedness of health systems for biological and chemical terror attacks, including links between health and security services and a simulation exercise.

nphi.title: CORRAL – COVID-19 response and recovery alliance for Montenegro and Western Balkans
nphi.with: Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin (Germany); Clinical Centre of Montenegro; Institute of Public Health of Montenegro; WHO Country Office Montenegro
nphi.summary: Supported COVID-19 response via lab and genomic surveillance, clinical training, a virtual EOC and a regional field epidemiology network.

nphi.title: BoCO-19 – Corona Global – Burden of COVID-19 population health metrics
nphi.with: National Association of Public Health (Albania); Public Health and Reforms Center (Azerbaijan); IPH FBiH & PHI Republika Srpska (Bosnia and Herzegovina); NCDC Georgia; Al-Farabi Kazakh National University; 'Healthy Future' (Kyrgyzstan); IPH Kosovo; Mongolian National University of Medical Sciences; IPH Montenegro; University of Belgrade (Serbia); Ministry of Health (Türkiye); Ukrainian Institute on Public Health Policy & Public Health Center (Ukraine); Tashkent Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education
nphi.summary: Harmonised burden-of-disease methods for COVID-19 and tested them for outbreak surveillance.

nphi.title: Gamaleya–Torlak technology transfer for local Sputnik V production
nphi.actor: Gamaleya National Research Centre for Epidemiology and Microbiology
nphi.with: Institute of Virology, Vaccines and Sera Torlak
nphi.summary: Following an April 2021 technology-transfer agreement, the Torlak institute in Belgrade produced Sputnik V, with the first batch passing quality control at the Gamaleya Centre in May 2021.

nphi.title: EURO NITAGs – Strengthening NITAGs in middle-income WHO EURO countries
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Europe – VPI Programme
nphi.summary: Built capacity of immunization advisory groups for evidence-based recommendations.

nphi.title: EU Initiative on Health Security (2020–2025)
nphi.with: National public health institutes and ministries of health of EU Enlargement and Neighbourhood countries
nphi.summary: DG NEAR-funded €9 million programme through which ECDC built epidemic intelligence, risk assessment, preparedness and field-epidemiology (MediPIET) capacity in 21 neighbourhood and enlargement countries and integrated them into ECDC…

nphi.title: ECDC IPA6 project – One Health AMR and SARI surveillance in the Western Balkans and Türkiye
nphi.with: National public health institutes of the six Western Balkan beneficiaries and Türkiye
nphi.summary: DG NEAR-funded ECDC technical assistance (2020–2024) on One Health antimicrobial resistance and enhanced SARI surveillance, bringing Western Balkan and Turkish experts into ECDC networks such as E-SARI-Net as observers.

nphi.title: SHARP JA – Strengthened International Health Regulations and Preparedness
nphi.actor: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
nphi.with: Public Health Wales (UK partner); THL (coordinator); RIVM; NIJZ; AGES; Switzerland took part as a collaborating partner with its own funding
nphi.summary: A joint action to help countries implement the International Health Regulations and strengthen preparedness for serious cross-border health threats, including laboratory capacity and chemical threats.

nphi.title: JAHEE – Joint Action Health Equity Europe
nphi.actor: Italy-led consortium (lead author from Istituto Superiore di Sanità; the formal coordinating body is not confirmed)
nphi.with: Norwegian Institute of Public Health (FHI); ISS; Serbian and Bosnian partner institutes not named
nphi.summary: Helped participating countries design and pilot policies to reduce health inequalities in areas such as monitoring, healthy living environments, migration and health systems.

nphi.title: iPAAC – Innovative Partnership for Action Against Cancer
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: Institute of Public Health of Serbia 'Dr Milan Jovanović Batut'; NIJZ (coordinator); Sciensano
nphi.summary: Supported countries in implementing innovative cancer control approaches, such as cancer plans, genomics, screening and care pathways.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 075 – MediLabSecure (One Health biological risks in the Mediterranean, Black Sea and Sahel)
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); IRD; INIA; IZS Teramo; Avia-GIS
nphi.summary: EU-funded network led by Institut Pasteur with Italy's ISS that strengthened laboratories and public health institutions in 22 neighbouring countries to detect and respond to arboviruses and their vectors, including external quality…

nphi.title: EU Twinning Light: Improving microbiology diagnostic system quality for communicable disease surveillance in Serbia
nphi.with: Ministry of Health of Serbia; national reference laboratories; Institute of Public Health of Serbia 'Dr Milan Jovanović Batut'
nphi.summary: Italian–Serbian Twinning Light in which ISS-led experts carried out a gap assessment (Sept–Dec 2017) of Serbia's microbiology laboratory system against EU surveillance standards and the acquis.

nphi.title: MediPIET – Mediterranean and Black Sea Programme for Intervention Epidemiology Training
nphi.with: FIIAPP; FCSAI; ECDC (scientific lead); national public health authorities of partner countries
nphi.summary: An EU-initiated field epidemiology fellowship for Mediterranean and Black Sea countries. ISCIII co-implemented it with FIIAPP (2014–2017) and FCSAI (2018–2021); ECDC ran it alone from 2021 to 2025.

nphi.title: Improving Tobacco Control in the Republic of Serbia
nphi.actor: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
nphi.summary: A completed THL development or expert-cooperation project listed on THL's international consulting pages; the listing gives no further detail.
